messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=redwood-inference-prod severity=high alert=latency_p99_eu-west threshold=1.5s alert_id=A-12345 :rotating_light:

maria: acked. I'm on call, grabbing dashboards and logs.

sanjay: @maria thanks — do we know if it's regional or global? any model swap / rollout recently?

maria: looks regional (eu-west). no model deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot.

olivia: Confirming metrics: p95 jumped 0.8s -> 2.1s, p99 ~3.4s for eu-west past 3m. KV cache evictions spike at 1729407600. No error 5xx spike from API logs.

maria: quick query run:
```
# timeseries tail 5m
select percentile(latency_ms, 95), percentile(latency_ms, 99) from inference_requests where region='eu-west' and ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';
=> p95=2100ms, p99=3400ms
```

noah: Paging note — autoscaler started scale-down 8m ago in eu-west for low utilization, maybe too aggressive.

maria: I'm going to disable the scale-down for eu-west and bump min_replicas to 3, rolling restart batcher-service on eu-west-1.

pagerduty: Escalation: auto-escalated to sre-leads after 2m unacked (rotation: @noah).

sanjay: Customer impact check: telemetry shows ~12% of requests >1s in the last 10m. Top customer affected: acme-analytics (~30% of their calls are delayed). No failed requests, just slow.

olivia: Logs show high queueing time inside the batcher (queue_len up) and several KV cache misses for frequent keys. evict pattern matches background compaction at 1729407580.

maria: Exec: 1) disabled scale-down, 2) set min_replicas=3, 3) restarted batcher on node eu-west-1 (command: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/batcher-service -l region=eu-west`).

maria: monitoring... p99 trending down to 1.1s (5m after restart). still watching prefix cache warmup.

olivia: As a precaution, switching routing policy to prefer dedicated-capacity pool in eu-west for latency-sensitive customers for next 15m. Config snippet: `routing.priority=[dedicated, hosted]`

noah: Noted. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler logs — looks like the controller overshot target during a low traffic lull. We'll tune cooldown windows.

sanjay: Customer comms? product wants to know if we need an incident status page update.

maria: Low-impact for now (no errors), but ACME CSM alerted. I'll ping support to notify that we saw increased latency for a subset and we mitigated; follow-up planned if recurrence.

incident-bot: Alert status: acknowledged by maria at 1729407790.

olivia: p99 stabilized ~0.6s at 1729408100. KV cache hitrate improving.

maria: marking this as mitigated. I'll leave min_replicas change in place and create a follow-up ticket to adjust autoscaler cooldowns and investigate cache eviction pattern.

noah: assigned ticket INF-4821 for autoscaler tuning + runbook update.

pagerduty: Alert resolved: alert_id=A-12345 (closed by incident-bot)

maria: handing off to night oncall (@noah) for observation window 2h. If p99 creeps up again, escalate to SRE leads immediately. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-p95-p99

incident-bot: Thread closed — final p99 (eu-west): 0.6s at 1729408305.
